import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class Main {
    static void go(Scanner sc) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        Arrays.sort(a);
        System.out.println(a[n / 2]);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int t = 1;
        while (t-- > 0) {
            go(sc);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
